title: CiteLadder Visual Improvement Map
description: Machine-readable visual and interaction design improvement mapping from HeroUI v3 to CiteLadder design system primitives.

patternsAdapted: Micro-inset border lighting with shadow-xs and subtle border-border
Explicit SVG icon alignment without manual sizing hacks
Spinner overlay state preserving natural button width
Active pressed scale suppression on popup triggers

currentWeaknesses: Uniform active:scale-[0.98] creates jitter on popup/dropdown triggers
Secondary variant uses heavy border-border-strong fighting with card borders
Destructive variant has no visual difference between hover and active
Spinner layout shifts button content horizontally on pending transition
